subject: Integration deck + sprint wiring for ParcelPay onboarding
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Cook <jared@parcelpay.com>, Lina Moreno <lina.moreno@parcelpay.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Integration deck + sprint wiring for ParcelPay onboarding

Hi Jared / Lina —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Attaching the integration deck and a small bundle of sample client snippets that illustrate: (1) SDK setup, (2) endpoint migration patterns, and (3) basic retry/timeout settings. High level ask: can we lock a 60-minute kickoff next week to align the sprint wiring and API cutover window? Proposed slots: Monday Nov 23 10:00am PT or Tuesday Nov 24 2:00pm PT.

What I included in the attachments:
- integration-deck-v1.pdf — overview, responsibilities, and cutover-dependent milestones
- sample-client-snippets.zip — Python, Node, and Java examples (small README included)
- mutual-action-plan.xlsx — proposed milestone dates and owners

Key things to look at in the deck: sections 3–4 (SDK wiring) and section 6 (rollout + rollback triggers). Quick snippet from the Python sample (see full archive for more):

# python snippet: client initialization with backoff + timeout
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED", timeout=10, max_retries=4)
response = client.generate(prompt="ping")

This uses our client wrapper that sets a per-request timeout (10s) and exponential backoff up to 4 retries — good starter defaults for ParcelPay’s latency targets. We can tune timeouts by route.

Next steps:
- Confirm kickoff slot (prefer one of the two proposed)
- Please loop in anyone from SRE or procurement who should be on the kickoff call

Thanks — I’ll update the Mutual Action Plan after we confirm the slot.

—
Camila Reyes
Senior Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0148

On Wed, Nov 18, 2026 at 9:12 AM Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Jared / Lina —
> 
> Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Attaching the integration deck...

Thanks Camila — deck looks good at first pass. Quick notes from our side:

- We need official guidance on Go support — our platform team prefers a typed client. Do you have Go snippets in the sample bundle or a generated OpenAPI client?
- Our SRE asked specifically for recommended retry/backoff settings for long-polling endpoints (we have occasional 2–3s spikes). If you can call out per-route timeouts (e.g., streaming vs batch) that’d help.
- Procurement is looped on this thread for MSA/PO guidance. I’ve cc’ed them — Lina, can procurement share any internal timeline constraints?

We can do Nov 23 at 10:00am PT. Planning to invite 1 SRE + 1 platform engineer.

—
Jared Cook
Head of Integrations, ParcelPay
jared@parcelpay.com

Subject: Re: Integration deck + sprint wiring for ParcelPay onboarding — confirmed kickoff + prework

Thanks all — confirmed: Monday Nov 23, 10:00am PT for the 60-minute kickoff. Calendar invite to follow with agenda.

Prework checklist for ParcelPay (small asks so the kickoff is productive):
- Share preferred SLO targets for each route (streaming vs sync) — SRE
- Add the 2 engineers who will attend the call to the shared Drive folder (permission request sent) — procurement/admin
- Quick smoke: run the included Python example against our sandbox and paste any errors into the Drive notes page (we can triage during kickoff) — platform engineer

Internal deliverables we’ll publish before kickoff:
- Vanessa: sample-client-snippets.zip v1.1 (Go + updated Node retry wrapper) — ETA Nov 20 EOD
- Vivek: cutover + canary checklist (including metrics to watch) — ETA Nov 20 EOD
- Camila: updated mutual-action-plan.xlsx with milestone owners and target dates — ETA Nov 20 EOD

If procurement needs any docs (SOC2 evidence, DPA, MSA redlines), I’ve asked Lina to post links to the DocuSign/contract packet before the call.

Agenda (30/30 split):
- 00–30m: technical wiring (SDK languages, sample run, timeouts/retries, canary plan)
- 30–60m: milestones, procurement timeline, and immediate next steps

I’ll follow up with the calendar invite and add the Drive + DocuSign links into the MAP. Looking forward to getting this running.

—
Camila Reyes
